description: This file defines the BookingAttendeesService class with methods to manage booking attendees, including retrieving, adding, and notifying attendees within a booking system.

classes.name: BookingAttendeesService
classes.description: Service class for managing booking attendees, including retrieval, addition, and notification functionalities.

methods.name: getBookingAttendees
methods.description: Retrieves all attendees for a given booking UID.

methods.name: getBookingAttendee
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attendee by ID within a booking identified by UID.

methods.name: addAttendee
methods.description: Adds a new attendee to a booking, updates calendar, and sends notification if enabled.

methods.name: sendAttendeeNotification
methods.description: Sends an email/SMS notification to the attendee about their addition to the booking.
